authority.claimDetail: 581/40 remain contract target/classification; this contract does not claim runtime implementation
authority.supersedes: PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 factColumns string placeholder (superseded at adapter revision 3)

key.meaning: sub-identity: state/resource/judgment/settlement/rule/interference/summon-type name; multi-value dimensions use the frozen multiRowKeyVocabulary keys (damage.power/damage.segments/damage.penetration/damage.type, state.primary/state.secondary); window.adjustTurns/window.settlementRatio are scheduled-fact keys on 时窗修正 scheduledFacts entries, not DirectFactRow rows; empty allowed for plain damage

sourceActionId.meaning: candidate action/declaration id that produced the effect

sourceActorId.meaning: unit id of the acting unit

sourceEffectId.meaning: effect instance id (path identity); required for dependency/causality

targetIds.meaning: actual candidate target ids resolved from 目标 via sourceAndTargetContext.targetResolution; empty or symbolic placeholders rejected

amount.meaning: declared magnitude; finite enforced by JSON schema and runtime validator; direction by sign

unit.meaning: POWER=威力倍率 declared, ABS=resource absolute points, PERCENT, RATIO=倍率, COUNT, TURNS, DISTANCE, BOOL

durationTurns.meaning: duration in turns; 0 when not applicable

multiRowKeyVocabulary.purpose: same-effect multi-values are expressed as separate rows with distinct keys under the same sourceEffectId; DirectFactRowV1 rows use damage.* and state.* keys (row uniqueness (sourceEffectId, key)); window.* keys are NOT DirectFactRow rows - they are the key field on 时窗修正 scheduledFacts entries; this vocabulary is frozen
multiRowKeyVocabulary.damage.power: 伤害结算 威力倍率 declared magnitude (unit POWER)
multiRowKeyVocabulary.damage.segments: 伤害结算 攻击段数 hit count (unit COUNT, positive integer)
multiRowKeyVocabulary.damage.penetration: 伤害结算 防御穿透 declared penetration (unit PERCENT)
multiRowKeyVocabulary.damage.type: 伤害结算 伤害类型 presence flag (unit BOOL, 1 applied)
multiRowKeyVocabulary.state.primary: 状态施加 数值 primary magnitude (unit PERCENT signed)
multiRowKeyVocabulary.state.secondary: 状态施加 副数值 secondary magnitude (unit PERCENT signed)
multiRowKeyVocabulary.window.adjustTurns: 时窗修正 scheduledFacts entry key (operation WINDOW_ADJUST); not a DirectFactRow row
multiRowKeyVocabulary.window.settlementRatio: 时窗修正 scheduledFacts entry key (operation SETTLEMENT_RATIO_ADJUST); not a DirectFactRow row

invariants: amount must be finite: JSON schema (type number) plus runtime validator rejecting NaN and Infinity
targetIds are actual candidate target ids; empty array and symbolic placeholders (自身/单体/群体/全场/召唤物/目标/target/actor/self) are rejected
sourceActionId/sourceActorId/sourceEffectId are required; missing source/context causes admit rejection (MISSING_SOURCE_CONTEXT) or explicit unsupported
rows carry declared magnitudes only; mitigation and hit final settlement are downstream kernel concerns, not projected here

SUPPORTED effects must produce at least one non-empty of directFacts/legalityModifiers/opportunityModifiers/scheduledFacts; otherwise unsupportedOutcomeKinds with explicit reason; column-name-only projection is forbidden
same-effect multi-values are separate rows with distinct frozen keys from multiRowKeyVocabulary under the same sourceEffectId; duplicate (sourceEffectId, key) rows are forbidden
机制授予 maxActions comes only from explicit 可用次数 on 主动触发; missing 可用次数 rejects MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD, no default 1; 随下次行动触发 forbids 可用次数 per runtime and projects no maxActions
triggerKey follows the registry enum 主动触发/随下次行动触发 only; 死亡时触发 is INVALID_OPTION_VALUE
nested 授予效果 payload is recursively projected as DirectFactRowV1 rows or explicitly unsupported/defer

selfChecks: schema validates every directFacts row and probe row in PrototypeDirectAdapterCasesV1
amount finite enforced at schema and runtime validator level
targetIds reject empty and symbolic placeholders
multiRow key vocabulary frozen; rows unique per (sourceEffectId, key)
maxActions explicit only; missing 可用次数 rejects; no default 1
